replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
Tbh probably because of competitive/friends. Most of my friends are banned or gone or have moved on to OCN. I'm only really here rn because I'm in a team with friends, no matter how inactive we are. I still like competitive Avicus, but it feels a bit dead atm. 

At the start it was because of my good irl friend (splade) and I enjoyed the server and eventually learned how to play. Basically I wanted to improve and so I kept trying to get better at the game and playing/trolling with him and the casual pub environment along with the super amazing community is what I stayed for. Honestly I can't say the same about the community anymore, though there are a few people I'll stay for like Nocturne, Team Allah + TNTPotato and a few more friends (I don't want this to run on forever). I carried that on by starting up competitive with The Game Changers (OG Apollo) and then moved onto Berzerk, who's friendgroup I was in and still feel like I'm at least semi part of.

I feel like really the only reasons I keep playing this game are because of friends, the fact I want to go out with a bang and the fact that I'd be too bored with life if I didn't play games. I've already made my impact here as a good frontliner, now what I really want is to carry that over to OCN and PotPvP. I guess I just want to prove to myself that I actually got somewhere and to those who still say I'm shit or mediocre that I'm more than that. That would be going out with a bang.

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
Prioritize game sense and OCN/Avicus skills first before anything. Playing pubs actually helps with this. They are what separates a shit player from an amazing player. You could be a sword and bow god and have all the raw talent in the world, but be completely useless because you can't do simple things like comm correctly, position at least decently or knowing when to play passively/aggressively. Knowing how to play as a teammate and not like a 1 man army is crucial and so is being able to be flexible. for example, most people see me as a frontliner and that's what I'm known for being as a player, but I can play most positions to at least a decent level. That in its own right is valuable. Getting playing experience in other positions also makes you a better player as a whole. You can take concepts from positions and apply them to different ones as well, improving your game as a whole. That and being a one-trick pony is detrimental to your team quite honestly. 

I've seen you be more mature as of late, but I still feel like you can snap sometimes and be impatient with people. I really haven't seen you as a competitive player, so yeah. Junior mod rank is a bit iffy for me because of the amount of chances you've had to date. That being said, as previously stated, you've been more mature as of late, so I'm interested to see how things work out.

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
I think you're rather chill, though through association with Varsity, people tend to label you as toxic. I think you're a good player, just be more aware and make sure your comms are heard, because sometimes you speak rather softly when coming, especially where you're going and when you push I find. Issue is that it can make you hard to hear. If someone doesn't hear you it can lead to dumb, outnumbered pushes and bad desicions by the shotcaller because they don't have that info. Make sure it's heard and people know what you're doing.

Tbh I don't really care, I find semi-toxic humour pretty entertaining and it's really just satirical.

I've only seriously started playing OCN a year ago, so I'd say either the update to 1.8 or more likely the update to 1.9. 1.9 basically half-killed the competitive community and didn't really help the server at all imo.

Probably along the lines (for a us OCN team):
Loo, Epsi, ginie, lordblox, caram, DemApplez/silentstriker (if he was active), Cyclones, OmarGlow, HattoWolf, Dax

If you want a balanced roster ye a bit harder.

Something like that. Couldn't think of any defenders off the top of my head for some reason so.
